title: Preserve the retained-history reading position during resize
observable_contract: While browsing retained history, width/height resize bursts preserve the logical top-of-view anchor instead of replacing it with the cursor position. Scrolling establishes a new anchor; selecting/copying preserves it. Returning to the live tail retains native behavior, and tiny or oversized viewports remain bounded.
result_policy: Test reports describe a particular artifact and run; no historical pass is asserted here.
